meta.scoreFormula: scoredRecovery = grossVariance x confidence; confidence = 0.45(same-claim control) + 0.10(>=5 control lines) + 0.30(validated payer evidence, -0.10 if lineage under investigation) + 0.10(original remit) + 0.05(post-transition published rate), clamped to [0.05, 0.95]
